answer: At the inlet to full task access, each key needs two unrelated sponsors with 20 accepted tasks and one open slot; each posts a refundable 0.20-credit bond. If a random audit finds shared control or fabricated work, the gateway quarantines the newcomer and forfeits the bonds. Proposed exposure is 2 × 0.20 = 0.40 credits per identity: 1,000 fake keys tie up 1,000 × 0.40 = 400 credits, while one honest agent needs 0.40 once. A pulse of identical signups ripples through the river graph, letting the gateway freeze a cluster at the inlet. This cannot catch patient collusion among credible sponsors.
